items.title: 11.4 Mass aur energy ki masawat (equivalence) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Special theory ke mutabiq mass aur energy alag cheezein hain magar ek doosre mein badal sakti hain. Kisi cheez ki kul energy E aur mass m ka rishta yeh hai:
Yahan m cheez ki speed par depend karta hai. Ruki hui halat mein cheez ke mass mₒ ke barabar energy ko rest mass energy Eₒ kehte hain:
mc², mₒc² se bara hai; energy ka yeh farq (mc² − mₒc²) harkat ki wajah se hai aur yahi cheez ki kinetic energy hai:
Eq. 11.4 se, energy mein tabdeeli ΔE ki wajah se mass mein tabdeeli Δm yeh hai:

c² bohat bari value hai (9 × 10¹⁶ m² s⁻²), is liye mass mein thori si tabdeeli ke liye energy mein bohat bari tabdeeli chahiye. Rozmarra zindagi mein energy ki tabdeeliyan itni chhoti hoti hain ke mass ka farq naapa nahi ja sakta. Magar nuclear reactions mein energy aur mass ki tabdeeliyan bilkul inhi equations ke mutabiq payi gayi hain.

blocks.caption: Mass aur energy ek nazar mein
rows: m cheez ki us speed par mass hai
ruki cheez ke mass mein chhupi energy
harkat ki wajah se zaid energy
aam energies ke liye bohat chhoti, nuclear reactions mein naapi ja sakti hai

blocks.prompt: Electron ka rest mass 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg hai; us ki rest mass energy nikalein. Agar tez speed par rest mass mₒ barh kar m ho jaye to kinetic energy kya hogi?
blocks.explanation: Eₒ = mₒc² = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg × (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)² = 8.2 × 10⁻¹⁴ J (taqreeban 0.51 MeV). K.E. = (m − mₒ)c².

blocks.prompt: Rozmarra zindagi mein hum E = mc² ke asraat kyun nahi dekhte?
blocks.explanation: c² = 9 × 10¹⁶ J kg⁻¹ bohat bara hai, is liye aam energy ki tabdeeliyan (jaise pani garam karna) mass ko itna kam badalti hain ke naapa nahi ja sakta. Nuclear reactions mein mass ka farq naapne ke qabil hota hai aur bohat si energy ban kar zahir hota hai.

items: Mass aur energy ek doosre mein badal sakte hain: E = mc² (11.4); Eₒ = mₒc²; K.E. = (m − mₒ)c²; Δm = ΔE/c².
c² bohat bara hai, is liye rozmarra mass ki tabdeeli naapi nahi ja sakti; nuclear reactions in equations par poore utarte hain.
